area: game fix: the death-cinematic tuning fallback claim was false for four input classes, now enforced and tested

find.report_claim: cycle 147 shipped _death_cinematic_tuning with the claim that a malformed block 'can never break the death screen', and cycle 147 recorded that claim in cycles.md and evidence/cycle-147.json
find.live_evidence: no test covered the tuning reader at all; probing it directly found five probes across four input classes that raise: start_fov 0 and start_fov 400 (CameraKey rejects a lens outside 0..180), start_forward 0 (CameraKey cannot look at its own position), non-monotonic key times, and a first orbit key at time 0 (both rejected by CameraPath, the second because it collides with the builder's implicit key at 0.0)
find.consumer_evidence: the claim was load-bearing for a designer editing juice.json by hand: the failure mode was a ValueError inside the death screen, not a graceful first-person fallback

read: keystone/camera_path.py CameraKey.__post_init__, look_at and CameraPath.__init__ validation
killed: trusting the earlier claim: a probe of six hostile blocks proved four of them raise
clamping start_fov into range instead of falling back: a designer who typed 400 wants the authored default, not a silently different lens
sorting bad key times: it would silently reorder an authored beat order, which is a creative decision the code should not make
analyze.survivor: fall back per field for lenses, look-ahead and radius, and fall back to the whole authored time list when the sequence cannot be strictly increasing after the opening key

fix.shooter: shooter/game.py adds a minimum= parameter to _number and a _lens() helper; start_forward and radius require a strictly positive value, start_fov and every key fov require 0 < fov < 180, and the time list falls back to all defaults when the first orbit key is not strictly after 0.0 or any pair is not strictly increasing; tests/test_death_camera_path.py gains 7 tuning tests (missing/garbage block, per-field fallbacks, lens range, valid override honoured, no-height key, a hostile-block sweep over all four failure classes, and an end-to-end malformed-juice death that still builds a 3.4 s cinematic)

shooter.repro: probe of six hostile blocks: before the fix start_fov 0/400, start_forward 0, non-monotonic times and a key at time 0 all raised ValueError; after the fix all six build a cinematic
shooter.mutation: replacing the start_fov _lens guard with _number failed the lens-range and hostile-block tests; disabling the monotonic guard failed the hostile-block test; shooter/game.py restored byte-identically (sha256 match)
shooter.pixel_identity: a fresh death capture diffed against evidence/c147_death_tuning/after_c147_death_tuning_death.png reports 0 changed pixels, so the hardening changed no rendering
